title: Zcash Pitches & Narratives · using the library
text: Original OpenZcash educational copy in English, Brazilian Portuguese and Spanish. Choose Pitches for examples or Narratives for the underlying ideas. Each pitch has a one-sentence, approximately 30-second and approximately 60-second version. Search the current language and filter by audience and theme. Prepare a pitch selects an existing reviewed example; it does not generate a new AI response. Copy text copies the selected version; Copy link opens that example with its language and length. Expand Make it your own for context and limitations. The library has no Sources tab or external reference links.

title: Zcash Pitches & Narratives · select and print / imprimir / impresión
text: In Pitches, check Select for printing on a card. Selected cards gain a gold outline and a Selected for printing label. Selecting does not open printing. After selecting at least one card, click the yellow Print selected button with the selection count in the results toolbar. It calls the browser print dialog, where Save as PDF may be available. Printing uses the selected pitches with the current language and length, including previously selected pitches that later become hidden when filters change. A hidden card cannot be selected until filters make it visible again. Clear selection removes the selections. Selection is held in page memory and is not saved in a copied link or across reloads. If an embedded browser does not show its print dialog, open the same page in a browser that supports printing and select the cards again.

title: Zcash Pitches & Narratives · idiomas, filtros, copiar e imprimir
text: A biblioteca tem textos originais em inglês, português brasileiro e espanhol. Pitches reúne exemplos de uma frase, cerca de 30 segundos ou cerca de 60 segundos. Narrativas explica a ideia, os fundamentos e os limites. A busca usa o idioma selecionado; os filtros selecionam público e tema. Preparar um pitch escolhe um exemplo existente. Copiar texto copia a versão atual; Copiar link abre esse exemplo no idioma e extensão escolhidos. Para imprimir, marque Selecionar para impressão; o cartão ganha contorno dourado. Depois clique no botão amarelo Imprimir selecionados. Marcar não abre a impressão. O navegador abre seu diálogo; salvar como PDF depende dele. Selecione um cartão enquanto ele está visível. Se um filtro depois esconder esse cartão, ele continua selecionado para impressão. Para selecionar um cartão oculto, primeiro ajuste os filtros para mostrá-lo. A seleção não fica no link e se perde ao recarregar. Não há aba Sources ou links externos de referências. Se um navegador embutido não abrir o diálogo, abra a página em um navegador com suporte à impressão e selecione os cartões novamente.

title: Zcash Pitches & Narratives · idiomas, filtros, copiar e imprimir
text: La biblioteca ofrece textos originales en inglés, portugués brasileño y español. Pitches reúne ejemplos de una frase, unos 30 segundos o unos 60 segundos. Narrativas explica la idea, los fundamentos y sus límites. La búsqueda usa el idioma elegido; los filtros seleccionan público y tema. Preparar un pitch elige un ejemplo existente. Copiar texto copia la versión actual; Copiar enlace abre ese ejemplo con su idioma y duración. Para imprimir, marca Seleccionar para imprimir; la tarjeta recibe un borde dorado. Después pulsa el botón amarillo Imprimir seleccionados. Marcar no abre la impresión. El navegador muestra su diálogo y puede permitir guardar como PDF. Selecciona una tarjeta mientras está visible. Si un filtro después la oculta, sigue seleccionada para imprimir. Para seleccionar una tarjeta oculta, primero ajusta los filtros para mostrarla. La selección no se guarda en el enlace y se pierde al recargar. No hay pestaña Sources ni enlaces externos de referencias. Si un navegador integrado no abre el diálogo, abre la página en un navegador con soporte de impresión y selecciona las tarjetas de nuevo.

title: Crosslink · Ongoing Test · testing, cTAZ and incentives
text: The Crosslink guide has Participate, Community tools and Incentives tabs. Participate offers Test, Build and Operate paths. Test uses a separate test wallet and cTAZ only: install and privately back up, sync, compare a block height AND hash on the same network, get test funds, choose a finalizer and stake, retarget a bond, then unbond and withdraw in allowed windows. Check advancing finalized height too. Record build, OS, time, transaction IDs and expected versus actual behavior; never include keys or seeds. Listed community issues are not assignments or promised funding. Incentive allocations, earned rewards, claims and reported payouts are different states. Curated release and round notes are dated snapshots; confirm current compatibility and claim windows in the linked program sources. Test cTAZ is not mainnet ZEC.

title: ZCG Participate · community proposals and demo Zcred
text: Participate lets visitors explore proposals and discuss ideas with a verifiable history. Participation uses free demo Zcred. Demo participation, community feedback and an official committee decision are separate. A committee verdict does not establish payment or delivered work. Zarvis reads public records only; it cannot see private drafts or committee workspace records, post comments, submit applications, spend credits or vote on the visitor's behalf. Public applications, decisions and payment records must be checked with their respective readers and dates.

title: Private Chat · Nym experimental pilot
text: OpenZcash links to an experimental Private Chat pilot using Nym. The page hosts an isolated chat service inside the site. This is a separate service from Zarvis. Zarvis has no access to its rooms, messages or identities. A pilot label does not establish a security audit, universal anonymity, uptime or suitability for a particular threat model. Consult the service's own current interface for its available features.

title: Zarvis · knowledge, tests, system and capabilities
text: Zarvis answers questions about Zcash and OpenZcash using reviewed references, indexed public pages and read-only tools. Static documentation describes workflows; live tools return data with freshness and coverage. It does not read the whole repository, internal test reports, private committee workspaces, deployment dashboards or wallets. A source revision, editorial review date or local preview does not prove tests passed, a PR merged or a production release succeeded. For build, test and publication status it needs current evidence for that exact version; without that evidence the status is unverified. It can draft original pitches adapted to an audience, occasion, channel, language and length, grounded in the library; a draft is not a new verified fact. Reloading clears chat memory. Model answers send recent context and retrieved public records to the configured provider. Availability and limits are shown on /zarvis/about.

title: Zarvis guide · badges, try-these questions, answer anatomy, depth
text: The interactive guide at /zarvis/guide teaches the Zarvis chat by showing it. Live badge samples rendered by the same code as the chat say where an answer came from: Direct from OpenZcash data · no AI, or a model answer naming the model and counting its sources. Try these questions links open /zarvis with the composer pre-filled; nothing is sent until the visitor presses send. An annotated sample answer marks the badge, the sources list, the withheld-figure notice and the copy/share actions. Quick answers are written within 55 seconds and Deep analysis within 110; quotas, retention and limits stay on /zarvis/about.

title: Coinholder Grants · Proposals
text: The permanent Proposals page at /coinholders/proposals shows the current round, Q4 2026. It lists open applications from the Financial-Privacy-Foundation/ZcashCoinholderGrantsProgram GitHub repository with the exact label Ready For Vote - All Steps Completed, created from October 30 through December 31, 2026. If FPF provisionally retains a hidden application, its entry links the public forum decision. Decided, withdrawn and cancelled applications are excluded. Search by title, applicant or organization, filter by category and sort by amount or date. View proposal opens the details and links the application source on GitHub or the forum. Requested amounts reflect applicants' latest edits. The FPF schedule accepts proposals October 30–November 13, reviews November 16–December 16 and schedules voting December 17–29, 2026. Each closing deadline is 20:00 UTC. Official submission status is not approval, payment or a vote result. Counts, requested USD and labels are checked on access with a five-minute cache. A stale or unavailable source is marked explicitly; an unavailable source does not mean zero proposals. This static guide cannot establish current proposal counts or funding totals; consult the page and its last successful check. Sources & method contains the exact eligibility label and source link. The page refreshes every five minutes while visible; Refresh also checks the current cached list. Results, Voting activity and Verify default to the active cycle, Q4 2026, with a pending state and the same announced timeline. Q3 and earlier outcomes are selected by round; activity archives currently cover Q3 2026 only. Q4 has no published result, vote-chain tally or verification yet. The program overview and fund show the current cycle separately from historical approvals and payments. FPF announces quarterly cycles; later dates are not inferred automatically.

title: Zcash Opportunities: quests, bounties, jobs and testing
text: OpenZcash Opportunities is an ecosystem directory. It links visitors to Gleyo quests and communities, public ZEC Bounties tasks, Yukon HashSmash challenges, Shielded Labs Crosslink testing and incentives, and official careers pages. OpenZcash does not run these programs or accept applications, submissions, payments or registrations. A read-only server import shows approved, public, unassigned, unexpired mainnet ZEC Bounties records, refreshed on access with a fifteen-minute cache. Source failures are marked; curated links remain available. The default listing order is mixed for each visit. Filters include type, platform, language and country; missing locale information is not inferred. The 29 matte-paper stock covers can be selected and downloaded. Prepare activity assembles a local brief using Gleyo or ZEC Bounties fields, offers text copying and cover download, and directs the user to publish on the chosen platform. It does not create an account, reserve funds or publish a bounty. Quests may offer XP without ZEC. HashSmash follows Yukon rules and has no additional OpenZcash monthly prize. Crosslink links to /ongoing-test/crosslink?tab=incentives. Job availability and application requirements must be confirmed with each employer. The earlier illustrative tasks and rewards were retired. Preparacao local de arte e texto, com cadastro e participacao somente na plataforma de origem.

title: OpenZcash Treasury · voluntary donations, public viewing key and contributions
text: OpenZcash Treasury is the project's own community-supported treasury, separate from ZCG and Coinholder program funds. The owner-supplied mainnet donation address and public full viewing key are available with copy controls and a QR generated locally from the exact address. Amounts and recoverable text memos are public; donors should not include personal information in memos. A memo reading "For Michae2xl: retroactive work" designates a donation to Michae2xl for work already delivered; donations without that note go to maintenance and improvements. A separate local watch-only worker scans the account and publishes reconciled snapshots to a read-only GET API. The page refreshes every 15 seconds, showing confirmed balance, net incoming and outgoing movements, recoverable memos, sync block and UTC time. Outflows include network fees; internal pool transfers are netted. Missing data stays unavailable and older or failed updates are labeled. The dedicated Vizor account was created on 2026-11-10; the scan starts before that date. A local preview does not establish a public scanner deployment. MIT source release is planned without a grant; public release is in preparation. OpenZcash will not apply for a grant for itself, neither to ZCG nor to the Coinholder retroactive grants. Contributor incentives depend on available funds, with a published scope, budget and acceptance criteria. Read the open letter at /openzcash-treasury/letter, published in English. Opportunities leads to the Crosslink guide.

title: OpenZcash · open letter, open source, donations and a public treasury
text: Open letter on the continuity of OpenZcash: it expresses pride in the pioneering work with Zarvis and the copilots, Zcash's funding history in Since block zero and the governance tools. OpenZcash will not apply for a grant for itself, neither to ZCG nor to the Coinholder retroactive grants. The commitment is to release the code under MIT, receive voluntary donations in a dedicated wallet and share its viewing key with the community. The address and public viewing key are on the Treasury page, with balance and history shown only once the scan has been synchronized and reconciled. The key cannot spend funds and may reveal amounts and memos. A donation whose public memo designates Michae2xl for work already delivered is treated as such; donations without that note go to maintenance and improvements. The letter is signed by Michae2xl. Publication of the code is still in preparation. Contributor incentives will depend on available resources, with scope, budget and acceptance criteria set beforehand. The letter is published in English and links back to OpenZcash Treasury.
